No.656/PUSSGRC Dated23/02/2023
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited for the appointment of (05) Guest Faculties to teach the subject
of Law at UILS, Panjab University Swami Sarvanand Giri Regional Centre, Bajwara,
Hoshiarpur for the Even Semester, Academic session 2022-23.
The applicants are required to fill the application form for the Assistant Professors available
on the Panjab University Website as per link given below:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf (Pages 1-
10).
The candidates should attach the attested copies of their certificates and other relevant
documents along with duly filled application form.
The applications complete in all respect should reach in office of
the Director, Panjab University Swami Sarvanand Giri Regional Centre, Una Road,
Allahabad, Bajwara, Hoshiarpur-146021 through Speed Post/Registered Post/By Hand
upto 03.03.2023 (4:00 p.m.)
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1000/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 25,000/- per month.
The eligible candidates will be informed for attending interview telephonically and through
email.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending interview.
Sd/-
Director
